title: run --cloud and the overview ignore the factory run's project; a frozen 'running' record is attached forever
description:
cloudRunsForEpic (run_cloud.go:171-178) matches on epic only, so 'ticfac run abc --cloud' in repo A attaches to repo B's run for epic abc; the overview lists every project's runs and reads this repo's records/PR for them. run --cloud decides attach vs resume from the record state alone and never consults cloudRunLiveness, so a dead instance behind a 'running' record is attached to forever. status/watch by epic id never look in the factory.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding c27650821772d08c0479dcc2f249ac309af148220fead1ebf1fea58cf008c4e3 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-xbp/attempt-32): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A5. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/c27650821772d08c0479dcc2f249ac309af148220fead1ebf1fea58cf008c4e3.json on the run branch.
